b: One of my favorite Lebanese home-cooked dishes! Siniyet Kafta is made with seasoned kafta, fried potatoes, tomatoes, onions, and a flavorful tomato sauce.
- 1 kg kafta (I use my homemade kafta mixture)
- Onions, cut into quarters or rounds
I personally prefer cooking the kafta on the stovetop first instead of putting everything raw in the oven. I find the texture much better this way!
Variation: You can also add sliced bell peppers with the tomatoes and onions. They taste delicious with the tomato sauce.
I serve mine with rice, but it's also delicious with fresh Lebanese bread. ❤️
